integrity: One unified finite target membership classification. Proof gives necessary and sufficient inequalities and explicit factor witnesses. Deterministic computations test samples and a strict-positive counterexample; computations are not substitutes for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite real 3 by 3 targets only; no targets with infinite entries, no higher dimensions, no proof of unique factor parameters, and no independent mathematical audit. Equivalence in unindexed earlier work and subsequent revisions of the cited v1 are unresolved priority risks.
title: Exact finite \(3\times3\) min-plus Bruhat cells and their missing polyhedral chamber
